pages.text: The Ogre Merchant is a coward, a professional, and—when paid—a remarkable source of useful contraband.$(br2)He travels with guards whose strength reflects nearby tribal anger. Threaten him and the escort answers; trade with him and he offers a changing stock of food, relics, tools, and rare goods.
Every Merchant carries exactly one Fort Map trade and always offers the Ogre Truce service.

pages.title: Premium Stock
pages.text: Gold buys ordinary stock. Diamonds and Golden Ogre Teeth open the more interesting pockets of his pack.
